headline: Frontier Posts Shift Amid Heavy Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest changes are in Nevish Line and Weathered Expanse. Nevish Line now counts six Colonial bases, two Warden and none neutral, against four, three and one before; nine event rows arrived in the latest two hours, 39 in the day. Weathered Expanse has swung to five Warden, one Colonial and three neutral, from an even three apiece and three neutral; nine recent rows make it the busiest live ledger, with 58 across 24 hours. Linn’s Mercy now stands seven Colonial, two Warden and two neutral, one fewer Warden-held base and one more neutral than the prior return; five rows came in the latest two hours. Elsewhere, Mooring County remains wholly Warden-held, with 16 daily events but none in the last two hours. Stonecradle’s eight-to-one Colonial-Warden balance is unchanged; its 14 daily rows have gone quiet recently. Callahan’s Passage shows sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments, though no base events are logged. War 140’s required victory tally remains 34 towns.
